reviewScope: Immutable frozen snapshots only; no active source edits, Cargo, SSH, Windows, browser or test execution. Current actual root diagnostic session84257 unaffected.

findings.trigger: A synthetic allowed64hex credential represented in uppercase and prefixed net::ERR_ matches the current errorText grammar. This is not proof Chromium actually emitted hostile text or any real credential leaked.
findings.mechanism: requestFailure copies any matching <=80 uppercase/digit/underscore suffix into the frozen failure. main clears run cookie/CSRF variables but then serializes the already retained failure to the local Node report file. An arbitrary matching suffix is not a finite Chromium NetError enum allowlist.
findings.containment: Observer _safe is CASE-INSENSITIVE raw/secret substring checking. It rejects reading/copying such report into outer TLS evidence, retaining overall FAIL. _node_raw also drops secret-containing base64. No FAIL-to-PASS bypass found.
findings.minimalFix: After root terminal/reap, use the same finite static NetError name set in Node and Python. Unknown strings, including prefixed64hex, become OTHER in Node and are rejected if passed unnormalized to observer. Preserve first-fault snapshot, bounds, immediate NETWORK_LOAD_FAILED and exact original budgets.
findings.disclosureCorrection: Initial parent message incorrectly described observer _safe as case-sensitive; later direct read proved raw.lower/secret.lower. The correction was immediately sent to root and service. This report records the actual narrower Node-local-output issue.
